title: Large beings with withered limbs inside a Martian pyramid

tellings.quote: Um down into the pyramid. And uh it was um it was beings that are much larger than humans,

plain: Inside a pyramid on Mars, in a region called Cydonia, there are beings much larger than humans, with withered limbs. That is what a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells Jesse Michels, describing it as something he saw himself as he went down into the pyramid, and he gives no date. If true, it would mean someone once lived, or still lives, on Mars.
